one_line: Corporate card and spend management platform with a REST API covering accounting, budgets, expenses, payments, team, transactions, and travel.
auth_notes: OAuth2 authorization with org admin approval; API keys also supported. Requires an active Brex business account (paid product, enterprise focus) to obtain credentials.
self_serve_notes: No free tier — requires a Brex business account; API access must be approved by the org admin. Enterprise sales often involved.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Roughly 100+ endpoints across Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Fields, Onboarding, Payments, Team, Transactions, and Travel APIs, defined via OpenAPI.
api_surface.webhook_note: Dedicated Webhooks API for real-time event notifications (confirmed in fetched docs navigation).

existing_mcp.note: Brex MCP is listed in the official developer docs navigation; community servers also exist.
